rumour.paper.title: THE TALK OF THE TOWN
rumour.paper.beat.1: They say a schoolboy beat one of the regulars. {0} wants a rematch and is already setting up the pieces.
rumour.paper.beat.2: The club is discussing a game with a boy. {0} says there hasn't been a loss like it all year, and means it as a compliment.
rumour.paper.garden.1: The allotment contest: among the prize-winners is a schoolboy with a plot by the Terraces. His bed neighbours want the secret.
rumour.paper.cure.1: The sanatorium talks of a young guest who saw his course through to the last stamp without missing a single treatment.
rumour.paper.job.1: A new worker in town: a schoolboy has taken a job {0}. They say he's managing.
rumour.paper.radio.1: “Volna Lyudmilovska” played a young listener's request. The town listened and sang along.
rumour.paper.fine.1: A fare dodger was fined on the train. A schoolboy, they say. The platform ticket boxes work: five roubles.
rumour.paper.crows.1: The crows, they say, bring a certain boy presents: buttons, bottle caps, shiny keys. Owners of keys are asked not to worry.
rumour.paper.kite.1: A kite higher than all the others was seen over the cliff. A schoolboy flew it; he held the reel tight, they say.
rumour.paper.tune.1: Someone plays “{0}” in the evenings. A schoolboy teaching himself by ear, they say.
rumour.paper.sing.1: They sang to a guitar by the bonfire on the beach. A boy from the club played, they say.
rumour.paper.sail.1: The Luch sailing school has a new pupil: a schoolboy who, they say, asked straight away where the boat's rudder was and where its brakes were. A boat has no brakes.
rumour.paper.capsize.1: The pier applauded yesterday: a sailing school newcomer capsized right by the railing, righted the boat and sailed on. The gulls were not amused.
rumour.paper.regatta.1: The pier talks of nothing but yesterday's race: first across the line was a schoolboy who in spring didn't know which rope was the sheet.
rumour.paper.tow.1: Yesterday the coach's launch towed in a Luch with a young helmsman, who waved to the spectators as if on parade.
rumour.paper.skipper.1: The sailing school has a new certified helmsman: a schoolboy passed all nine lessons. Now he takes a boat out alone, fifty roubles a go.
rumour.paper.film.1: At the old newsreel in the Rassvet the whole hall laughed, loudest of all a schoolboy in the third row.
rumour.paper.dance.1: At the Saturday dance at the Vaults a new schoolboy didn't miss a single waltz. His partner, {0}, says he never once trod on her foot.
rumour.ps.cup: P.S. Is it true {0} is yours now? The whole yard talks of nothing else.
rumour.ps.garden: P.S. We heard about your plot and the prize. Congratulations! Send some seeds if you can spare them.
rumour.ps.beat: P.S. They say you beat the most experienced player at the club. {0} is still shaking their head.
rumour.ps.cure: P.S. They say you finished the whole course at the sanatorium. So now you're healthy enough for two.
rumour.ps.job: P.S. We heard you're working {0}. Well done! Just don't forget your lessons.
rumour.ps.tamed: P.S. They say you have a new friend with wings: {0}. Take care of it.
rumour.ps.radio: P.S. We heard your request on the radio! We turned it up.
rumour.ps.fine: P.S. And another thing: they say you got fined on the train. A ticket is five roubles, don't be stingy.
rumour.ps.crows: P.S. Is it true the crows bring you presents? If they bring our spoon, send it back.
rumour.ps.catch: P.S. They say you've had a catch: {0}! Come round some time and teach us.
rumour.ps.kite: P.S. We saw your kite over the cliff. Higher than all the rest!
rumour.ps.tune: P.S. They say you play “{0}”. Will you play it for us when you come?
rumour.ps.sing: P.S. We heard about the singing by the bonfire. A pity we weren't there.
rumour.ps.film: P.S. We saw you at the Rassvet. How did you like the old films?
rumour.ps.dance: P.S. They say you dance at the Vaults, and your partner is {0}. Mind, the whole yard knows now.
rumour.ps.sail: P.S. They say you've joined the sailing school. Fair winds! And do your life jacket up.
rumour.ps.capsize: P.S. We heard you capsized right by the pier. The main thing is you came up smiling.
rumour.ps.regatta: P.S. They say you won a race! Send us the cutting from the paper.
rumour.ps.tow: P.S. They say the launch towed you home. It happens; the wind's fickle.
rumour.ps.skipper: P.S. We heard you've got your helmsman's certificate now. Will you take us out in summer?
dev.action.rumour.cup: Rumour: the hero won a cup
